# Frappe MCP

> Standalone, permission-aware Model Context Protocol server for Frappe developers. Runs as a local MCP stdio process and connects to a development site over Frappe's HTTP API. It creates and edits DocTypes, customizes standard forms, checks site/app drift, exports customizations to app files, and sets up Workflows, Notifications, Report Builder reports, and Workspaces, previewing every change. It is not installed as a Frappe app.

## Important rules

- Start with `get_site_info`, then read the DocType schema before building filters or write payloads; do not assume an ERPNext or HRMS catalog.
- Use Frappe's permissions. A permission denial is final; do not work around it.
- Preview mutations and confirm only after review. Updates and deletes require the preview's exact `modified` token; exports and rollbacks require the `preview_id`.
- Write files only into an explicitly configured local app; review the diff and commit through Git. The server never migrates or deploys.
- Do not expose credentials in prompts, committed config, logs, or test evidence.
- Arbitrary SQL/Python, unrestricted method dispatch, and fields Frappe evaluates as code are not provided.
